_meta.description: Per-arm revenue beside a fixed revenue target and the date the figures were cut on, via AGG_CONSTANT: the target comes from the request params (expr "params.target", typed f64) and the cut date is a literal date constant (emitted as epoch days, as AGG_MIN on a date field writes it). The same values sit in every group row; the slots read no field and need a label.
